name: Smokeping
description: Smokeping keeps track of your network latency. For a full example of what this application is capable of visit UCDavis.
short_desc: Smokeping keeps track of your network latency
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: MASTER_URL
form_fields.hint: Specify the master url to connect to. Used when in slave mode.

form_fields.label: SHARED_SECRET
form_fields.hint: Specify the master shared secret for this host. Used when in slave mode.

form_fields.label: CACHE_DIR
form_fields.hint: Specify the cache directory for this host. Used when in slave mode.
